title: FlyLo MVS 3.8J/TK5 backend validation
summary: Validate the FlyLo airline backend independently of the browser on stock-style MVS 3.8J TK5. ED209ZZ is the clean-room reference target: inventory first, preserve evidence, qualify the installed toolchain from exact PROC/PGM facts, then execute deterministic airline semantic slices.
semantic_invariants: Operational path validity is distinct from commercial/ticket validity.
Session/company/ruleset authority must not bleed across FLYLO, OurLadyAir, Drax Air Freight or Zorin Industries.
A later coupon is rejected while an earlier coupon remains OPEN unless the exact issue ruleset permits an explicit waiver.
Baggage profiles are ruleset/product data, not one global airline constant.
Zorin forwarder context does not grant Drax or FLYLO operator acceptance.
FLCTL submission is idempotent and restart state is durable.
External aviation standards are adapter/profile concerns; internal fixed records do not become compliant by resemblance.

terminal_operating_rule: Use one 3270 session at a time and plan the command sequence before sending it.
After successful HERC01 login, the blank screen is the TSO command environment; do not treat it as a hang.
Do not open extra LUs to probe around a slow or blank screen; inspect the existing session and host/VTAM evidence first.
Do not send ordinary MVS recovery commands through Hercules stdin and assume they reached MVS.

provenance.claim: Clean-room validation directive and deterministic backend acceptance semantics.
